identification: Two unframed Rand McNally 'Star Chart for Southern Skies' wall charts, edited by Dr Oliver Justin Lee (Dearborn Observatory, Northwestern University), copyright Rand McNally & Company, made in U.S.A. White-on-dark-brown/black celestial map, rolled, hung with clips. Classic mid-20th century classroom pull-down chart (the originals are about 45 x 45 inches). Unknown whether this lot is original linen-backed or a later poster reprint.
